scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring opening customer distress regarding unexpected movie rental charges and giving a cold copyright citation during a second emotional outburst at turn 44 in the final third.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never provided a restatement of the unauthorized on-demand purchase dispute, jumping directly into transaction logs.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked the customer to repeat the number of movie titles and total disputed charge at turn 48, which Riley had already explicitly detailed at turn 5.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused to take ownership of an on-demand billing dispute, deflecting responsibility onto the customer and refusing full refund escalation despite accidental child purchases.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 61 while the customer was mid-sentence asking about mobile tablet spending controls, failing to confirm resolution.

grader.scenario: Unauthorised movie purchases on on-demand store by visiting grandchildren
grader.notes: Short poor call (11:50) handled by Mark. Customer's visiting grandchildren accidentally purchased £84 in pay-per-view movies. Agent verified security and enabled a zero-spend lock, but failed 5 distinct criteria: Empathy (two unhandled outbursts, including in final third), Active Listening (repeat question on titles/amount), Ownership (refused full refund escalation), Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing), and Paraphrasing (no restatement).

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent verified billing address and 4-digit security PIN within first 240 seconds.
